Risk: under queue worker scaling (2+ workers polling the `high` queue), the read-then-write check in DispatchDomainEventsJob::handle() (lines 37-39 and 78-81 of app/Jobs/DispatchDomainEventsJob.php) is NOT atomic: both workers can pass the `dispatched_at !== null` guard before either writes, broadcasting twice. backend_contract.design_pattern: CLAIM-THEN-BROADCAST-THEN-FINALIZE-OR-RELEASE. The broadcast MUST happen OUTSIDE any open DB transaction (project invariant: commit_before_dispatch). Strategy in 3 phases:
backend_contract.phase_1_claim_atomic: Open a SHORT DB::transaction(function() use (&$claimed, &$domainEvent, &$skip) {...}). Inside, re-fetch the DomainEvent with ->lockForUpdate(); if not found OR dispatched_at !== null, set $skip = true and return (transaction commits a no-op). Otherwise, IMMEDIATELY mutate the row to claim it: forceFill(['dispatched_at' => now(), 'attempts' => $domainEvent->attempts + 1])->save(). The lock + claim mutation form one atomic block. Commit and release the lock.
backend_contract.phase_2_broadcast_outside_tx: After the transaction commits (so commit_before_dispatch invariant holds), perform contract validation + broadcaster->broadcast(...). NO DB transaction is open during the network call.
backend_contract.phase_3a_success: On successful broadcast, $domainEvent->forceFill(['last_error' => null])->save() (a tiny separate write to clear last_error if it was non-null from a previous failed attempt). The dispatched_at timestamp set in phase 1 stays as the claim/dispatch marker.
backend_contract.phase_3b_failure_release: If contract validation OR broadcaster throws, RELEASE the claim by forceFill(['dispatched_at' => null, 'last_error' => $e->getMessage()])->save() so the queue retry (tries=5/backoff) can re-attempt cleanly. THEN rethrow the original exception. PayloadMismatchException semantics preserved: last_error is populated AND the exception is rethrown (so the job lands in failed_jobs after `tries` attempts).
backend_contract.concurrency_acceptance: Given 2 worker processes competing on the same DomainEvent row, EXACTLY ONE broadcasts. The losing worker acquires the row lock AFTER the winner committed the claim, observes dispatched_at != null, sets $skip = true, and returns silently — no second broadcast.
backend_contract.logging: On the no-op path (dispatched_at already set after lock), emit Log::info('[DispatchDomainEventsJob] Skipped (already dispatched by concurrent worker)', ['domain_event_id' => $id]). On the failure-release path, the existing Log::warning in failed() still fires after `tries` attempts.
backend_contract.invariant_compliance: This pattern complies with commit_before_dispatch (broadcast happens only after the claim transaction is committed) AND defeats the worker race (claim is atomic via lockForUpdate). DO NOT wrap the broadcast call inside the transaction.

frontend_contract.ttl_ms: TTL = 10 * 60 * 1000 (10 minutes). Each entry stored as { id: string, ts: number }; on isDuplicateCorrelation lookup, expired entries are evicted lazily.
frontend_contract.storage: sessionStorage key = 'foodking_correlation_dedupe_v1'. Stored value = JSON array of { id, ts } entries. Read on module load; written on every mutation (insert / evict). Wrap reads/writes in try/catch — sessionStorage may throw under quota or privacy mode; on failure, fall back to in-memory LRU only and log once via console.warn.
frontend_contract.api_compatibility: isDuplicateCorrelation(correlationId) signature unchanged. __resetCorrelationDedupe() must also clear sessionStorage. Add new __forceLoadCorrelationDedupe() exported helper (test-only) that re-reads from sessionStorage — useful to assert persistence across simulated reloads in vitest.
frontend_contract.regression_guard: All existing callers (the rawHandler in onEvents, line 132) MUST keep working without code changes. Verify by running existing tests/js/eventContract*.spec.js or correlationDedupe*.spec.js if present.

non_negotiable_constraints: Backend: NEVER broadcast inside an open DB transaction (commit_before_dispatch invariant). The CLAIM transaction MUST be committed before broadcaster->broadcast() runs.
Backend: NEVER serialize/deserialize the DomainEvent in a way that bypasses the lock (use Eloquent DomainEvent::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($this->domainEventId) INSIDE the claim transaction).
Backend: NEVER hard-code 'pusher' connection — keep app(BroadcastManager::class)->connection() to remain test-friendly.
Backend: PayloadMismatchException semantics (last_error written, rethrown) MUST be preserved bit-for-bit, AND the claim MUST be released (dispatched_at=null) on failure so retries work.
Backend: attempts counter MUST increment exactly once per handle() invocation, regardless of broadcast success/failure (so tries=5 is respected).
Frontend: sessionStorage failure MUST NOT crash isDuplicateCorrelation — degrade gracefully with one console.warn at first failure.
Frontend: Default export surface (isDuplicateCorrelation, __resetCorrelationDedupe) UNCHANGED. New __forceLoadCorrelationDedupe is test-only (under __ prefix).
Frontend: TTL eviction MUST be lazy (only evicted on lookup) to keep the hot path O(1) — no setInterval, no timers.
All tests MUST run under the existing PHPUnit / Vitest configurations without new setup.
acceptance_criteria_measurable: Two simultaneous handle() calls on the same DomainEvent row → broadcaster invoked exactly 1×.
Two simultaneous handle() calls on DIFFERENT rows → both broadcast, no spurious lock contention.
Broadcaster throwing → transaction rolls back, dispatched_at NULL, exception rethrown for queue retry.
PayloadMismatchException flow: last_error column is populated and exception is rethrown.
Frontend dedupe survives a simulated tab reload (re-init module from sessionStorage).
Frontend dedupe entries older than 10 min are evicted on next lookup.
Frontend gracefully degrades to in-memory only when sessionStorage throws.
All existing tests/js/* and tests/Feature/Outbox/* tests still pass (no regression).
